name: Amazon SageMaker AI (inference and Feature Store)
sku: SageMaker AI inference endpoints and SageMaker Feature Store only. Training, notebooks and the rest of SageMaker AI are not scored.

serve.ml-serving.note: Deploys trained models to real-time endpoints for low-latency inference, serverless endpoints with automatic scaling, and asynchronous endpoints for large or long-running requests.

transform.feature-eng.note: Feature Store keeps features in feature groups with an online store for millisecond reads and an append-only offline store on S3 for training, and supports point-in-time extraction. Features are ingested by streaming or batch, which reduces training-serving skew.

presentation.tagline: Managed model endpoints and a feature store with online and offline modes.
